title: Heterogeneous graph neural network-based prediction of immune-related adverse events.
summary: Methods use 2,576 patients from a clinical data platform to train a heterogeneous graph model; Results report irAE prediction and risk patterns. Retrospective discrimination supports the specified clinical prediction only.
ai_technology: The graph model predicts immune-related adverse events from EHR medication and patient features, with reported discrimination and treatment-stage risk patterns. The Methods specify the learned operation used for this case-specific result.
